name: After Dark
blurb: Where the night stops pretending. Intense, but all invitation.

cards.text: Describe the moment tonight you wanted to kiss them but didn't. What stopped you?
Undress them slowly — their pace, their call. Every item comes off with eye contact.
cards.speak: While you do, say what you love about the person underneath, not just the skin.
cards.soften: Remove one item of their choosing, slowly.

cards.text: Mutual gaze, two minutes, no words. Hands on each other's hearts. The timer is the only voice.
cards.soften: One minute, eyes closed, foreheads touching.

cards.text: Trace their lips with one finger. They keep their eyes closed. Describe out loud what you want to do next — you don't have to do it yet.
cards.soften: Trace their hand instead. Same rule.

cards.text: What's something you've been curious about with me but never brought up? Curiosity is the only price of admission.
Sixty seconds: describe each other's body using only words you'd want said about your soul.
Kiss down their neck, unhurried. The rule: wherever you pause, you must say one true thing before moving on.
cards.soften: Three slow kisses, three true things.

cards.text: Trade answers: what does desire feel like in your body — and what makes it louder for you tonight?
